scope: this session transcript; workspace filesystem events except collector logs and runtime state
privacy: local only; permissions 0700 directories / 0600 files; no network upload
limitations: FSEvents can coalesce rapid changes; intermediate content versions may be unavailable.
Filesystem events identify paths, not the responsible process.
Files outside watch_roots require adding a root before changing them; structured Codex FileChange items are captured wherever present.
Command output is preserved as recorded by Codex, which may truncate output.
Content snapshots are limited to regular files <= snapshot_max_bytes; larger files retain stat metadata.
Transcript format is internal and can change on a Codex update.
